# Nikole Sparks, AMFT

> Depth-oriented, attachment-based individual and couples therapy in Newport Beach and Fullerton, California, and online throughout the state. Nikole Sparks is an Associate Marriage and Family Therapist (AMFT 150080, supervised by Dr. Michele Willingham, PSY 15849) who helps adults, teens, and couples understand the patterns beneath anxiety, relationships, identity, and life transitions.

Nikole works with people who look fine on the outside but feel that something has been off for a while. Her approach is warm and collaborative, slowing down to look at where feelings and patterns come from rather than only managing them on the surface. Sessions are available in person in Newport Beach and Fullerton, or by telehealth anywhere in California. Every service begins with a free 15-minute phone consultation.

## Services

- [Individual therapy](https://nikolesparks.com/services/individual-therapy/): Weekly, open-ended depth work on anxiety, identity, shame, grief, and the patterns underneath them.
- [Couples therapy](https://nikolesparks.com/services/couples-therapy/): Attachment-based therapy to work through conflict, disconnection, and communication patterns.
- [Premarital counseling](https://nikolesparks.com/services/premarital-counseling/): Explore attachment histories and expectations before a lifelong commitment.
- [Therapy for anxiety](https://nikolesparks.com/services/therapy-for-anxiety/): Understand what anxiety is responding to and protecting, rather than only trying to quiet it.
- [Therapy for creatives](https://nikolesparks.com/services/therapy-for-creatives/): Navigate burnout, creative blocks, and imposter syndrome by working with the emotional undercurrents beneath them.
- [Faith-integrated therapy](https://nikolesparks.com/services/faith-integrated-therapy/): Christian therapy that holds faith and psychological depth together, including deconstruction and questions of belief.
- [Religious trauma therapy](https://nikolesparks.com/services/religious-trauma-therapy/): Support for the lasting effects of harmful religious experiences.

## Writing

- [What Actually Happens in a Depth Therapy Session](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/what-happens-in-a-depth-therapy-session/): What a depth-oriented session is actually like, and why it works the way it does.
- [Insight Isn't the Finish Line](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/insight-isnt-the-finish-line/): Why the same pattern keeps returning even after you understand exactly where it came from.
- [High-Functioning and Still Anxious](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/high-functioning-and-still-anxious/): What happens when achievement stops working as a shield.
- [Why "Just Relax" Never Works](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/why-just-relax-never-works/): Anxiety as a signal to understand rather than a glitch to override.
- [When Burnout Looks Like Laziness](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/when-burnout-looks-like-laziness/): For creatives whose worth got tangled up in output, a slower way back to the work.
- [The Fight Isn't About the Dishes](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/the-fight-isnt-about-the-dishes/): The argument you keep having is usually carrying something neither partner has said out loud.
- [Before You Say "I Do"](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/before-you-say-i-do/): Three conversations most premarital couples skip, and end up having later with more at stake.
- [Grief Doesn't Need Fixing](https://nikolesparks.com/blog/grief-doesnt-need-fixing/): The pressure to move on usually belongs to everyone else; grief keeps its own time.
